rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: split:1.1: can: p469-strip1600.jpg header and hymn 481's system 1, the one stanza row: the word the split opens on is a name of God printed with a capital, but the header prints the metre 8.6.8.8.6. and the split cuts the 8-syllable line 1 into 3 and 5 syllables, six lines against the metre's five. split:1.4: can: p470-strip0.jpg, the end of hymn 481's system 2 and the start of system 3: the word the split opens on is a pronoun of God printed with a capital, but the header on p469-strip1600.jpg prints the metre 8.6.8.8.6. and the split cuts the 8-syllable line 4 into 4 and 4 syllables.
